How to Check for Errors in LG Air Conditioners To check for errors on your LG Air Conditioner , you need to observe the blinking patterns, numeric displays, or diagnostic tools built into your system.

Most modern LG wall-mounted or split air conditioners will communicate a system fault by flashing a specific numeric error code (such as CH01 or CH05) directly on the indoor unit's digital LED screen.

For a more advanced and immediate diagnosis, you can use LG’s Smart Diagnosis feature by opening the LG ThinQ mobile app on your smartphone, navigating to the tools menu, and placing your phone near the designated "Smart Diagnosis" icon on the indoor unit to let the app audibly or digitally scan your system for internal faults.

[LG Electronics Range] What types of dishes (containers) should not be used?
Do not use metal containers, stainless steel containers, earthen pots, or aluminum foil in microwave mode.
Metal materials reflect microwaves, which prevents food from heating and causes sparks.
Containers with gold or silver patterns may change color or cause sparks when used.
Use standard ceramic bowls.
If using glass containers, use heat-resistant glass that can be used on a gas stove.
